newsitem.title: USA: H.F. Ahmanson confirms consents a majority.
newsitem.headline: H.F. Ahmanson confirms consents a majority.

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson & Co said on Thursday that the consents delivered to Great Western Financial Corp represent a majority of outstanding shares calling for Great Western's meeting to be held by May 6.
Great Western has spurned a takover bid by H.F. Ahmanson, in favor of a friendly acquisition by Washington Mutual Inc .
H.F. Ahmanson issued its statement in response to an earlier Great Western announcement that said several of the consents were counted twice.
Ahmanson said that it would have a consents for a majority of the shares, even if the votes that were counted twice were disregarded.
